name: Kyousuke
source: He is a guy who only wants to have fun and doesn't get too worried about what's happening around him. That changes one day when he has to move to a dormitory. New place, new people and a new school. Will he make new friends and have a wonderful life? It's just one way to find out.
translation: He is a guy who only wants to have fun and doesn't get too worried about what's happening around him. That changes one day when he has to move to a dormitory. New place, new people and a new school. Will he make new friends and have a wonderful life? It's just one way to find out.
